title: First-time home buyer share falls to historic low of 21%, median age rises to 40 (2025 Profile of Home Buyers and Sellers)
key_point: 88% of buyers and 91% of sellers used agents; FSBO 5%; seller tenure 11 years; 24% buyers with children.

title: Highlights from the Profile of Home Buyers and Sellers
key_point: Market split between record all-cash buyers and record-low first-time buyers; mortgage rates averaged 6.69%.

title: Home Buyers and Sellers Generational Trends
key_point: 74% of buyers financed; student debt and rents delay purchases; 26% of younger millennials got deposit help.

title: Appraisal & Valuation
key_point: NAR concerned about GSE appraisal waivers, hybrid appraisals and appraiser shortages; advocates independent valuations.

title: Consumer Guide: The Appraisal Process
key_point: Appraisers mainly use MLS sales comparables adjusted for condition, renovations, amenities, location and size.

title: Selling Guide B4-1.3-08: Comparable Sales
key_point: Minimum three closed comps; 12 months preferred; same market area; similarity beats recency; listings supplementary.

title: Appraising Home Purchase Appraisals
key_point: About 30% of appraisals equal contract price, under 10% below; AVMs more informative about default risk.

title: Loss Aversion and Seller Behavior: Evidence from the Housing Market
key_point: Sellers facing losses list 25-35% of the loss gap higher, sell 3-18% higher, and sell less often.

title: Why is Intermediating Houses so Difficult? Evidence from iBuyers
key_point: Algorithmic pricing works only for liquid, easy-to-value homes; faster deals mean less accurate valuations.

title: Vision-based Real Estate Price Estimation
publisher: arXiv / Machine Vision and Applications (Poursaeed, Matera, Belongie)
key_point: CNN-scored interior/exterior luxury level plus size data beat Zillow estimates; visual condition matters.

title: Multimodal Machine Learning for Real Estate Appraisal: A Comprehensive Survey
key_point: Five modalities (attributes, market, text, images, GIS/POI); multimodal beats single-modality; text adds about 2% accuracy.

title: A spatio-temporal statistical model for property valuation at country-scale with adjustments for regional submarkets
key_point: Ireland: R2 0.83 Dublin vs 0.70 rural; MAPE about 14%; A-rated BER about +15%, G about -15%.

title: Scalable Property Valuation Models via Graph-based Deep Learning
key_point: Santiago, 200k houses: graph neural nets using neighbouring-house similarity improve price prediction.

title: Redfin Estimate
key_point: Median error 1.89% on-market, 7.38% off-market; 500+ data points; not a substitute for agent CMA.

title: One in Five House Hunters Is Willing To Compromise Personal Safety to Afford a Home
key_point: 78% safety must-have, 74% low crime, 68% low disaster risk; 22% would trade safety; 41% families trade schools.

title: AI can estimate a home. An appraisal can inform the decision.
key_point: Appraisal Institute president: AVMs miss condition, unusual features, local costs, and renovation cost vs value.

title: Builders gut check what buyers may like vs. what they'll pay for
key_point: John Burns survey: price, location, construction quality top; design/style only sixth; functional spaces valued.

title: Luxury buyer interest doubles, demand shifts to larger properties
key_point: International luxury searches up 100%; about 40% of specialists say clients trade condition for location.

title: Longevity emerges as key driver of luxury real estate demand
key_point: Sotheby's $10M+ survey: lifestyle top factor (62%), then taxes and stability; 38% cite aging-in-place.

title: One portal's share of agent discovery traffic dropped for the first time ever. Here's why.
key_point: Vendor study: 67% of buyers use AI for research; 71% of queries hyperlocal; Zillow discovery share fell.

title: Is the Zestimate era coming to an end?
key_point: AVMs don't know the home; future valuations combine AI with owner-supplied renovation and condition data.

title: Study finds Zillow home estimates improve buyer, seller outcomes
key_point: Marketing Science study: Zestimates raise buyer surplus about 6% and seller profit over 4%; bigger gains in low-income areas.

title: AI can help sellers list homes, agents still drive net proceeds
key_point: 91% of sellers used agents, FSBO 5%; agent value is pricing against buyer behaviour and negotiation.

title: Every real estate agent has AI now, how sellers spot real expertise
key_point: Sellers should probe comp selection; comps miss floor plan, natural light, road noise.

title: Private listings come up short as coming-soon listings gain ground, study finds
key_point: Off-MLS listings sold 0.87-1.26% below AVM expectation; coming-soon 1.16-1.38% above; bigger urban penalty.

title: Is Kelley Blue Book another company coming for your commission?
key_point: KBB Homes claims within-3% accuracy using owner photos and condition; Zestimate off-market error about 7%.

title: Making Sense of Valuation's Alphabet Soup: CMAs, BPOs, AVMs and Appraisals
key_point: CMA sets list price, BPO probable sale price, AVM model value, appraisal collateral value; used together.

title: Pricing Strategy: Do You Have One?
publisher: RISMedia / NAR Center for REALTOR Development
key_point: CMA comps adjusted for market; absorption rate frames market; overpricing lengthens time on market.

title: RPR Wins 2026 'Real Estate Analytics Platform of the Year'
key_point: RPR AI CMA scores comps by similarity, editable criteria, outputs four pricing strategies.

title: Quality Control Standards for Automated Valuation Models
key_point: Effective Oct 2025: AVMs need accuracy, anti-manipulation, conflict controls, testing and nondiscrimination compliance.

title: International Valuation Standards
key_point: IVS has seven general standards incl. data and inputs and valuation models, plus asset standards.

title: European Valuation Standards (EVS 2025)
key_point: EVS 2025: market value basis; EVS 6 requires reflecting energy efficiency and EU renovation obligations.

title: PIRI 100: the ultimate prime residential property index
key_point: Global prime +3.2% in 2025; Dubai leads; London budgets lower under tax rules; turnkey scarcity.

title: Europe's prime housing markets in focus
key_point: London declined; Spain, Portugal, Italy gained; tax stability and governance top cross-border criteria.

title: London learns to share the spotlight
key_point: $10M+ sales rise globally but London moves backwards; non-dom exit; London keeps institutional breadth.

title: London's Chelsea neighbourhood: a curated collaboration
key_point: Chelsea food-and-drink venues up 70% since 2020; curated retail drives neighbourhood desirability.

title: Our top 10 hottest housing markets around the world
key_point: Global lifestyle buyers value culture, privacy, water/views, walkability; Chelsea and Upper East Side listed.

title: The Residence Report 2026/27
key_point: About 1,800 branded schemes in 90 countries; wellness becomes core infrastructure; branded residences command premiums.

title: The Wealth Report 2026
key_point: Hub page only; detailed data in gated PDF.

title: The Appraisal Journal - Recent Issues
key_point: Issue listing only; article content requires member login.
